title: Lives of the Necromancers
author: William Godwin
description: "Lives of the Necromancers" by William Godwin is a historical account published in 1834.
longDescription: Godwin's final book examines paranormal legends and magical beliefs from western and Middle Eastern history, tracing tales of sorcery, witchcraft, and supernatural powers from ancient civilizations through the Dark Ages.

authorInfo.bio: William Godwin (1756–1836) wrote Lives of the Necromancers. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
